notes: Modelled: steel bezel with a 90-notch coin edge, dark ceramic insert with the white triangle, numerals and minute bars as traced inlays, polished inner lip, applied indices with polished frames and lume (round dots, triangle at 12, bars at 3, 9 and 6), sword hour hand with lume blade, black cross guard and pommel, minute hand with arrow tip and stepped tail, black seconds needle with a lume dot, fluted crown between two crown guards, brushed lugs, three-column bracelet.

From the photo map: blue gradient dial with the wave relief, TISSOT 1853, SEASTAR, PROFESSIONAL 600M / 2000FT, POWERMATIC 80, SWISS MADE, the date window (31) and the black flange with its minute track.
Under the hands the dial is a smooth fill (the wave relief does not repeat); it is covered by the 3D hands.
Scale is the listed 46 mm case. Heights are estimated from the listed 15.8 mm (no side photo). The helium valve sits on the case side at 10 and is not visible from the front.
